unmapped.note: The TEI sourceLine1 word אליהו is not visibly confirmed in the top main-line region; sourceLine2 begins בעל מום. Do not equate TEI sourceLine with image-line numbering.
Tractate closing/opening headings and added מדליקין above the line are source-layout evidence, not inferred new running text.

Top main line visibly contains חייב before פטור, while ולוקט appears above the line. These layout/correction features are recorded as image observations only; no additional running-text word ID or editorial replacement is inferred.

limitations: Original-page overview, full-column consonantal attempts and individually observed vowel features are separate evidence levels. No evidence level implies complete manuscript-pointing verification.
Most word records are uncertain because a complete inventory of vowels, dagesh/rafe and shin/sin marks has not been resolved; clear individual features do not certify the full word.
Consonants aligned after actual image inspection are not a source-independent full diplomatic transcription.
Scan texture and tiny/faded points prevent confident two-point/three-point and patach/qamats distinction in several regions; enlargement adds no source detail.
No source text, pointing, morphology or meaning was changed.
Column reading attempts were typed independently but are fallible AI visual transcriptions; exact agreement with source consonants is not independent human confirmation.
All 34 main columns were attempted; words without mandatory unique exact consonant match remain unresolved. Unmapped typed strings are preserved rather than repaired from expected source text.
Full vowels, dagesh, rafe, shin/sin distinction and correction-hand attribution remain unresolved except for the individually recorded positive point features.
Only consonants match at the counted exact-anchor positions; this count cannot be presented as complete Accordance or complete manuscript-vocalization agreement.
The 185 earlier upper-line alignments and 10 feature-bearing word positions are retained separately from independent mandatory unique consonant matches.
completionStatus: All 34 assigned main columns now have independently typed consonantal attempts. Exact-match source positions are explicitly bound; failed attempts and unmatched positions remain open. Complete word-by-word pointing verification remains unfinished.
